claims.question: q3
claims.claim: 76% of enterprise CX buyers are open to outcome-based pricing, but as of July 2026 only 5% were contracted on it, a 15x gap.
claims.quote:
These companies typically sell to enterprise CX buyers, 76% of whom are open to outcome-based pricing models, according to HFS Research.

Still, as of July 2026,[only 5% are contracted on outcome-based pricing.](https://www.hfsresearch.com/research/outcome-based-pricing-effort-based-contracts/)

Ultimately, that reveals a 15x gap in what the market says it wants and what it has signed.
